Your private information (passwords, recovery seed phrases, private keys, keystores, personal government IDs, or tax details) **will never be committed to the GitHub repository**.

* Private keys & certificates (`*.keystore`, `*.jks`, `*.p12`, `*.key`, `*.pem`, `*.mobileprovision`, `*.p8`)

The landing page has been redesigned to be professional, interactive, and organized according to your exact specifications.

### Summary of Improvements

1. **Professional & Interactive Experience**:
   - **Interactive Quantum Ambient Canvas**: An ambient particle field (`<canvas id="bg-canvas">`) that moves smoothly and repels/reacts to your cursor.
   - **Interactive Live Wallet Simulator**: A phone frame mockup showcasing real-time on-device interactions:
     - **Multi-Chain Portfolio**: Live network switcher across Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, Solana, and Bitcoin with dynamic USD balance recalculation.
     - **Dynamic EIP-1559 Gas Estimator**: An interactive slider adjusting Gwei (Eco, Fast, Instant) with real-time transaction fee USD calculations.
     - **Hardware Secure Enclave Auth**: Interactive Face ID / Biometrics simulation with scanning animation and instant signature feedback.
     - **On-Chain ENS Name Resolver**: Test resolver supporting names like `vitalik.eth` and `vault.eth`.
   - **12+ Chain Matrix**: Category filter buttons (*All Networks, Layer 2 Rollups, EVM Mainnets, Non-EVM, Testnets*) with active simulated RPC ping latencies.
   - **Security Architecture Bento & Comparison Matrix**: Direct side-by-side comparison of VaultETH vs. Standard Wallets vs. Centralized Exchanges.
   - **Interactive FAQ Accordion**: Expandable questions with smooth animations.
   - **Interactive Feedback**: A glass toast notification system when copying addresses or interacting with networks.

2. **Official Badges for Apple & Android Devices**:
   - **"Available on Apple Devices" / App Store**: Official Apple vector icon with compatibility specs (*iOS 17+ • iPadOS • Apple Silicon macOS*).
   - **"Available on Android Devices" / Google Play**: Official Google Play multi-color vector icon with specs (*Android 10+ • Keystore AES-256 GCM*).
   - Displayed in the **Hero section**, in the dedicated **Download Spotlight section**, inside the **Sidebar Drawer**, and in an interactive **Download & QR Modal**.

3. **Slide-Out Sidebar Navigation Drawer**:
   - Removed loose buttons from the header and main layout.
   - Added a fixed glassmorphism navigation bar with an animated hamburger button (`☰` ➔ `✕`).
   - Clicking opens a slide-out drawer organized in clean order:
     - **Explore**: Home & Overview, Live Simulator, 12+ Blockchains, Hardware Keystore, FAQ.
     - **Legal & Support**: [Privacy Policy](https://github.com/ganiyucall911/VaultETH/blob/main/docs/privacy.html), [Support & FAQ](https://github.com/ganiyucall911/VaultETH/blob/main/docs/support.html), and GitHub Repository.
     - **Platform Downloads**: Quick links for Apple devices and Android devices.
     - **Hardware Status**: Live on-device keystore status indicator.
   - [privacy.html](https://github.com/ganiyucall911/VaultETH/blob/main/docs/privacy.html) and [support.html](https://github.com/ganiyucall911/VaultETH/blob/main/docs/support.html) were also updated with matching Liquid Glass styling and the shared sidebar navigation drawer.

All requested enhancements and interactive capabilities are fully implemented, verified, and saved:

### Key Additions & Interactive Features

1. **Interactive Theme Glow Accent Switcher**:
   - Added a live neon palette selector in the navigation bar and drawer:
     - **Electric Cyan** (`#00F5FF`)
     - **Hyper Violet** (`#A855F7`)
     - **Cyber Emerald** (`#10B981`)
     - **Solar Amber** (`#F59E0B`)
   - Dynamically shifts CSS variables, glows, and borders across the entire site in real time.

2. **Full Transaction Lifecycle Simulation inside Phone Mockup**:
   - After biometric authorization (Face ID / Secure Enclave scanning), users can now click **"Broadcast to Ethereum RPC"**.
   - Simulates `eth_sendRawTransaction` and block inclusion with a live receipt:
     - **Status**: Block `#21,084,912` confirmation
     - **Transaction Hash**: Clickable with instant clipboard copy (`0x8f2c3d1e...`)
     - **Gas Used**: `21,000 gas • 18.5 Gwei`
     - **Reset Demo**: One-click reset to run through again.

3. **Live RPC Node Latency Ping Tool**:
   - Added a **"Refresh RPC Nodes"** button on the 12+ Chains Matrix.
   - Triggers simulated live RPC ping tests with spinning animation and randomized latencies across all 12 chains (`14ms` – `35ms`).

4. **Dynamic Card Spotlight Effect**:
   - Cards (`.bento-card`, `.chain-card`, `.platform-card`) now track cursor coordinates (`--mouse-x`, `--mouse-y`) with subtle radial gradient illumination following the cursor.

5. **ScrollSpy Navigation**:
   - As users scroll, the top navigation links dynamically highlight based on the active viewport section (`#simulator`, `#networks`, `#security`, `#download`, `#faq`).

6. **Interactive Platform QR Code Switcher**:
   - The download modal allows instant toggling between **Apple iOS** (App Store / TestFlight) and **Android** (Google Play / APK) download modes and QR codes.

7. **System Clipboard Integration**:
   - Copying addresses, ENS lookups, or transaction hashes uses the native `navigator.clipboard` API with animated toast confirmation.
